title: MiG-29M / M2 (MiG-35 family)

sources.title: JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)

intro: The MiG-29M is a redesigned MiG-29 with a new airframe, colour screens and digital fly-by-wire, in which the stick asks for a turn rate instead of moving the control surfaces directly; the M2 is the two-seat version, and the MiG-35 grew out of this family. JoyPro takes its controls from the MiG-29SMT and the 9.12, so this guide follows the SMT guide.
